variants.name: 700 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Mixture with vegetables for guinea pigs
  • Grain-free formula with high fibre content for healthy teeth
  • Naturally varied mixture full of herbs and grasses like timothy hay, with tasty vegetables and fruits such as peas, beetroot and rosehip
  • Essential vitamin C for improved resistance
  • Tasty mixture with extruded morsels for optimal intake and digestion, no pressed pellets. No artificial colours, flavours or preservatives
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: derivatives of vegetable origin (timothy, grasses and herbs 19.5%), vegetables (peas 7%, beetroot 5.5%), fruit (rosehip 1%), vegetable protein extracts, seeds, minerals, FOS, MOS, algae, yucca.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 16%, crude fat 3.0%, crude fibre 14.5%, crude ash 7%, calcium 0.7%, phosphorus 0.55%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 10820 IU, vitamin D3 1300 IU, vitamin E 85 mg, vitamin C 210 mg, iron 108 mg, iodine 2 mg, copper 11 mg, manganese 80 mg, zinc 76 mg, selenium 0.2 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: An average daily portion of 35–50 g is recommended, depending on your guinea pig's size and breed. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature Timothy Hay and make sure hay is always available. Refresh drinking water daily. For extra variety, combine with Nature Snacks. Tip for picky eaters: only refill the bowl when it is empty, so every meal stays balanced.
